material_exception: unique BC/N/ORM bake private to this asset (not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2): the task for the unclaimed families asks for a baked set per asset, and the surface detail here (see dresses) does not exist in the shared library
pivot: base centre (bbox centre in X/Y, mesh bottom at z = 0), front on -Y
dresses: pyramid roof, 11.8 m square and 4.3 m tall, in heavy mossy stone slates with four hip rolls and a ball finial
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound in families.json
known_weaknesses: Four flat faces with the stone slates in the textures: no slate edges on the silhouette, no sag, no snow (the family name is the house, not the weather). Hip rolls are plain swept bars. Rendered on the ground; in use it sits on the timbered storey. One 4096 px bake covers the whole building, about 100 px/m: it holds at the gameplay camera and is soft at 1 m (a tiling masonry material with trim would be the engine-side answer). Walls are flat slabs with the coursing in the textures; the inside is a dark core, not a room. One convex hull is exported.
stacking: place at z = 5.8 m on SM_Snow_House_Timber_PR
